_note: Baidu photos of the terminal and a Lufthansa A320neo alongside an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

ber-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，柏林勃兰登堡机场（BER）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
ber-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

ber-baidu-1.webp.zh: 柏林勃兰登堡机场航站楼的玻璃幕墙上写着“BERLIN BRANDENBURG AIRPORT”和“WILLY BRANDT”，下方是标有B12、B13的登机口与伸出的登机桥，面前是一片宽阔的停机坪。
ber-baidu-1.webp.en: The glass facade of Berlin Brandenburg Airport's terminal is lettered “BERLIN BRANDENBURG AIRPORT” and “WILLY BRANDT”, with gates B12 and B13 and their boarding bridges above a wide apron.

ber-baidu-2.webp.zh: 一架汉莎航空的空客A320neo（注册号D-AINZ，机身上涂有“Hauptstadtflieger”与“BER”字样）停在柏林勃兰登堡机场航站楼前的停机坪上。
ber-baidu-2.webp.en: A Lufthansa Airbus A320neo (registration D-AINZ, carrying “Hauptstadtflieger” titles and BER markings) stands on the apron in front of Berlin Brandenburg Airport's terminal.
